episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Cheon Sa-rang begins her job at King Hotel — despite the occasional hiccups. Gu Won struggles to integrate himself into the family business.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After an awkward interaction, Sa-rang and Won get off to a bad start — later embarking on a trip together. Sa-rang faces relationship problems.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: During their contentious trip, Sa-rang and Won share a moment of vulnerability. While Sa-rang later earns praise, Won faces hostility from his family.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Won navigates his sudden feelings for Sa-rang. Sa-rang begins her new role — putting her closer to Won.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Won's unexpected attempts to get closer to Sa-rang leave her feeling confused. Meanwhile, Won disapproves of Sa-rang's work responsibilities.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Won hurries to Sa-rang during her time of need. After spending the following days together, Won asks her an important question.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Won continues to court Sa-rang, despite her hesitance. An Arab prince visits the hotel and begins competing with Won for Sa-rang's attention.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Prince Samir arranges a party for Sa-rang — much to Won's jealousy. Won later invites Sa-rang on a date, pulling out all the stops.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Won and Sa-rang navigate their relationship after their momentous night — later having to win the approval of an important figure in Sa-rang's life.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Won takes Sa-rang and her friends on a trip abroad, but struggles to find alone time with her. He later opens up about his past to Sa-rang.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: With much at stake, Won accepts the task of running the hotel's 100th anniversary. Sa-rang meets an employee who may hold clues to Won's past.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Won and Gu Hwa-ran attempt to figure out the future of King Group. Just as Sa-rang and Won's relationship solidifies, an unexpected guest arrives.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: An uncomfortable encounter leaves Sa-rang and Won in an awkward place. Won prepares his presentation — facing his family with his plans for the future.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Won and Sa-rang go into damage control after Hwa-ran's act of sabotage. Sa-rang receives a stern request from Won's father.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Won unexpectedly encounters a figure from his past. After he visits Sa-rang at her new location, he makes a decision about the hotel branch.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Sa-rang finally makes a decisive choice about her future. After delaying his plans to make room for Sa-rang's, Won approaches her with a question.
